cases.input: Weights are a time×asset matrix; a naive diff over axis 1 is described as turnover.

criteria: Flag dimension error: turnover is computed across time for each asset before aggregation, never across neighboring assets.

cases.input: A short’s point-in-time locate is unavailable, but source model treats it as 200 bps extra slippage.

criteria: Model as a skipped/missed entry (or explicit scenario); do not treat unavailable borrow as a fill.

cases.input: Full quoted spread is 40 bps, with entry and exit each assumed to cross the market.

criteria: Charge 20 bps half-spread per side or 40 bps round-trip for the two halves; state convention and do not double count to 80 bps.

cases.input: A strategy input provides price and weight change but no ADV units/currency.

criteria: Derive notional/quantity if inputs support it, but mark participation/capacity unresolved; do not substitute a universal floor.
